details:
I often use VRChat not just as a game, but as a shared space—somewhere to quietly spend time with friends, talk while doing other tasks, or simply be present together. In these situations, I keep VRChat running in the background as a social platform.

However, I’ve run into a recurring issue: VRChat picks up controller input even when I’ve disabled Steam Input and adjusted launch settings. It seems to detect devices through DirectInput or other low-level layers, causing unintended avatar movement and disrupting the experience.

This makes it difficult to keep VRChat open comfortably while doing other things. External tools like HidHide or reWASD can help, but I believe this kind of control should be available within VRChat itself.

Please consider adding a simple toggle to enable or disable controller input entirely, or officially supporting launch options like . It would make a big difference for users who use VRChat as a quiet, shared space alongside other activities.

Thank you for considering this request.
title: Add a toggle to disable controller input in VRChat
